title: 3.2.4b Lab — Add a Cylinder
description: Create a Cylinder with distinct radius and height values — a uniform tube shape in 3D.

steps.title: Create a Cylinder
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `cylinder = new Cylinder(0, 0, 0, 0.5, 3)` to create a cylinder with radius 0.5 and height 3.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Cylinder section for the constructor order.

steps.title: Give it a color
steps.instructions: Set `cylinder.color = 'slategray'` or any color you like.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the color property.
